message.content:
**Uno Rules (Standard Version)** | Step | Action | |------|--------| | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. If this card is an action card, follow its effect (see below). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (or counter‑clockwise if a Reverse card is played). | | **Playing a Card** | • On your turn, play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• If you cannot play a matching card, you must draw one card from the draw pile.
• If the drawn card can be played immediately, you may play it right away; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the direction of play.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color to match.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if the player has no other playable card; otherwise, they can be challenged.) | | **Wild Draw Four Challenge** | • If a player believes the previous player illegally used a Wild Draw Four, they may challenge.
• The challenged player must show their hand. If they had a playable card of the current color, the challenger draws six cards instead of four. If not, the challenger draws four cards. | | **Winning a Round** | • The first player to empty their hand wins the round.
• Score points:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Skip/Reverse/Draw Two: 20 points.
 – Wild/Wild Draw Four: 50 points.
• Add the winner’s score to their total. | | **Winning the Game** | • Play continues until a player reaches **500 points** (or another agreed threshold). That player is declared the overall winner. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can stack further. | | **Seven-O** | When a player plays a 7, they may swap hands with any other player. When a player plays a 0, all players rotate their hands clockwise. | | **Jump-In** | If a player has an exact duplicate of the top card, they may play it immediately, even out of turn. | | **Custom Rules** | Many groups add house rules (e.g., “Uno” shout requirement, penalty for forgetting to say “Uno”). | Enjoy playing Uno!
